item.title: Wilmington man fights landlord over mold, termite damage in trailer home
item.description: Robert Jones has lived in his Sunshine Apartments home for 11 years. He said problems escalated over the past few months, with floors collapsing due to missing floor joists and walls opening up.

item.title: 'Everything perfect about high school sports' | Lakota West defeats Princeton at Cintas Center
item.description: Lakota West defeated Princeton 58-53 in a Greater Miami Conference showdown at Xavier University's Cintas Center Friday night.

item.title: Ohio lawmakers debate ending data center tax breaks, creating commission amid community concerns
item.description: The lawmakers want to end the 100% sales tax exemption on construction materials, which allows companies to build massive server facilities without paying taxes on building supplies.
